issues.problem: Likelihood is sigmoid(upper)-sigmoid(lower) without compressai's sign trick (sign=-sign(lower+upper), abs(sigmoid(s*u)-sigmoid(s*l))). Mathematically identical, but in float32 the positive tail cancels (both sigmoids ~1) and clamps to 1e-9 / zero gradient earlier than compressai for z-hat above roughly +7..8.
issues.evidence: official compressai EntropyBottleneck._likelihood; the factorized-prior probe re-derives with the same plain difference, so it cannot see this
issues.fix: Use the sign form in likelihood_cm (and in the probe reference). Expected effect on PSNR/size is negligible because hyper latents start at 0 and stay small.

issues.problem: Official hyper stream is compressai rANS whose CDF only spans the quantile range [-10, 10] (quantiles stay at init) with Exp-Golomb escape outside; the port codes the full [lo, hi] range with the factorized CDF, so any |z-hat|>10 is cheaper here than in the official size. Also 32+32 header bits per channel vs official none.
issues.evidence: paper.md 7.4 acknowledges escape; code has no escape cost
issues.fix: None required unless many |z-hat|>10 are observed; log max|z-hat| in contextgs_size.json to bound the effect (<<1% expected).

issues.where: multi_scale vs code_levels (training vs coding partition)
issues.problem: Training partitions ALL anchors with masked-out ones collapsed to the origin (an extra pseudo-voxel at level 1), while bake partitions only mask-valid anchors. Because the verbatim level-1 gather order is positional, row alignment of level-1 context differs slightly between training and coding. Lossless (encode and decode agree) but the coded probabilities are not exactly the trained ones.
issues.evidence: official has the identical train/encode difference (multi_scale_generating passes mask_anchor_bool; conduct_encoding calls divide_levels(_anchor, None) on masked anchors)
issues.fix: None; faithful to official. Worth citing if the size gap vs paper is attributed to the level-1 quirk.

issues.problem: Truck low-rate row follows the paper appendix (7.72 MB, 26.00/0.885/0.150) but the official results CSV has 13107200 B = 12.5 MB, 25.845/0.880/0.154 for ContextGS_lowrate (CSV looks like a copy of the high-rate size). Only matters for T&T, not the current mip360 benchmark.
issues.fix: Add a note; keep the paper value as the target.
